models_evaluated: XGBoost sepsis prediction model with Shapley values

links.outcome: Model performance after deployment compared with pre-operations performance
links.effect: Pre-operations sensitivity 92%, specificity 93%, FPR 7%; post-deployment sensitivity 91%, specificity 94%, FPR 6%, i.e. comparable performance.
links.quote: Following deployment, the model maintained comparable performance, with a sensitivity of 91% and specificity of 94%.

links.outcome: False positive rate of new model versus currently deployed commercial model
links.effect: Post-deployment false positive rate of 6% versus 30% for the commercial model in the same health system.
links.quote: Notably, the post-deployment false positive rate of 6% represents a substantial reduction compared to the currently deployed commercial model in the same health system, which exhibits a false positive rate of 30%.

unlisted_practices: Iterative clinician feedback to select relevant model data elements

screen.reason: The study evaluates an XGBoost sepsis prediction model deployed in a live EMR system, reporting pre- and post-deployment performance metrics and comparing false positive rates against an existing commercial model.
